newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Weizman to Egypt on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Weizman to Egypt on Monday.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman will meet President Hosni Mubarak in Egypt on Monday, his office said on Wednesday.
It said Mubarak invited Weizman for the one-day trip.

Egypt in 1979 became the first Arab state to sign a peace treaty with Israel. Weizman, as defence minister at the time, was an architect of the Israeli-Egyptian deal and has tried to play the conciliator in Arab-Israeli peace moves since the election of right-wing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in May.
Weizman, whose presidential role is largely ceremonial, hosted Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Tuesday at his home in Caesarea, northern Israel.

Israel and Egypt have been locked in a war of words with Cairo accusing Netanyahu of foot-dragging on peace moves with the Palestinians including the long-overdue handover of parts of Hebron in the West Bank.
